entries.note: The order data, the one row without a label.

entries.wording: The package is on the way to the facility.
entries.note: Written twelve hours after the order data, before 17FEIA's warehouse receives the parcel; the shared rules would read it as transit.
17FEIA's warehouse in Shanghai or Shenzhen received the parcel; the first box of the tracking page's progress rail.

entries.wording: The order has information pending customer confirmation.
entries.note: The warehouse has the parcel and waits for the customer to confirm the order.
Export customs in China.

entries.code: 国内运输中，预计到达出境口岸时间
entries.wording: Domestic transit in progress; estimated arrival at exit port on: …
entries.note: The road leg to the border by truck; the date in its wording is an estimate, not the row's time.
The border crossing the truck leaves China by.
China's export release at the border, followed by its own time; the parcel is not held in customs.
The truck crossing into the EU, before import customs.

The truck reaching the place of import clearance, as a flight's landing at the clearance port, before the broker takes the shipment; its wording repeats the row's own time, and the shared rules would read it as customs.
An estimate written before the flight, followed by its date: no scan, so the adapter drops the row.
Between the estimated departure and the take-off: not a movement, so the row keeps the stage of the one before it.
The departure in the tracking page's progress rail; current replies label it 航班已起飞.
The landing before import customs; the shared rules would read it as customs.
The landing in the tracking page's progress rail.

entries.wording: Broker picked up Shipment and delivered to warehouse.
entries.note: The customs broker takes the shipment to its warehouse for clearance; the shared rules would read a delivery.

entries.wording: Arrived at delivery hub，Awaiting carrie scan.
entries.note: After the clearance, before the delivering partner's first scan: the parcel was handed in at the partner's depot and waits to enter its system.

entries.wording: The international shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: Relayed from DHL in Germany, with DHL's place, country and offset. The label marks every relayed row; the stage comes from the partner's wording.

entries.wording: The international shipment has been processed in the export parcel center
entries.note: Relayed from DHL in Germany.

entries.wording: The shipment will be transported to the destination country/destination area and, from there, handed over to the delivery organization.
entries.note: Relayed from DHL in Germany, for a parcel bound for France.
The last box of the tracking page's progress rail.

entries.wording: 包裹已做国内退回处理
entries.note: A domestic return: after the warehouse confirmed the order, the parcel goes back to the sender in China instead of leaving the country.
